
'''Yuga Daigongen''' (瑜伽大権現, 由加大権現)

* [[Yuga Daigongen]] – A deity in [[Shinbutsu-shūgō|Shinbutsu-shūgō]] (the syncretism of Shinto and Buddhism), with [[Amitābha|Amida Nyorai]] (Amitābha) and [[Bhaisajyaguru|Yakushi Nyorai Medicine Buddha]] (Bhaiṣajyaguru) as its [[Honji suijaku|Honji Buddha]] (original Buddhist counterparts).
* An alternate name for [[Yuga Mountain]] or a collective name for the two shrines below, which enshrine the above deity.
** An alternate name and enshrined deity of [[Yugasan Rendaiji]].
** An alternate name and enshrined deity of [[Yuga Shrine|Yuga Shrine Hongū]] and its affiliated branch shrines:
*** [[Yuga Daigongen (Asakuchi)]] – Located in [[Asakuchi|Asakuchi, Okayama]], [[Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]], in [[Kamogata, Okayama|Kamogata]].
*** [[Yuga Daigongen (Jinseki Kōgen)]] – Located in [[Jinsekikōgen, Hiroshima|Jinseki Kōgen, Hiroshima]], [[Jinseki District, Hiroshima|Jinseki District]], [[Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima Prefecture]].
*** [[Yuga Daigongen (Onomichi)]] – Located in [[Onomichi|Onomichi, Hiroshima]], Hiroshima Prefecture.
*** [[Yuga Daigongen (Mihara)]] – Located in [[Mihara, Hiroshima|Mihara, Hiroshima]], Hiroshima Prefecture.
*** [[Yuga Daigongen (Takehara)]] – Located in [[Takehara, Hiroshima|Takehara, Hiroshima]], Hiroshima Prefecture.
*** [[Yuga Daigongen (Tokushima)]] – Located in [[Tokushima (city)|Tokushima, Tokushima]], [[Tokushima Prefecture|Tokushima Prefecture]].
*** [[Yuga Daigongen (Tokushima, second shrine)]] – A second shrine of the same name within Tokushima City.
*** [[Yuga Daibosatsu]] – A shrine in Tokushima City.
